nom: SKIN1004 Lab in Nature Matrixyl 10 Boosting Shot Ampoule

avis.texte: This product seems to help my skin glow. I've only been using it for about 50-60 days but I do like it so far! It doesn't have a funny smell and doesn't seem to irritate my skin!

I've been using the Lab in Nature Matrixyl 10 Boosting Shot Ampoule, and so far the main thing I've noticed is that it gives my skin a nice boost of hydration. My skin feels softer and more moisturized after using it. I haven't noticed any major difference in firmness or fine lines yet, but I do like it for the added moisture. I'll probably continue using it to see if I notice more results over time.

I have had an issue of my skin looking very dull recently, I wasn't sure what to expect going into using this product because I've never used a product like this before and was a little intimidated, but it ended up being easier to use than I thought, I wanted to give it time to really work before I made a review and after a few weeks, I can definitely say that I can tell the difference in my skin. It feels smoother, brighter, and healthier. I definitely am interested to try more products by this company and keep this product part of my routine.
I love it, I use it at night and it has worked very well for me. It has micro needles that make the product enter the skin better.

I've been really enjoying the Lab in Nature Matrixyl 10 Boosting Shot Ampoule! The texture is rich but absorbs surprisingly well without leaving my skin greasy. I could feel a slight tingling sensation when applying it, which is expected but it wasn't uncomfortable. After a week of consistent use, my skin feels more hydrated, smoother, and looks a bit firmer. I also noticed a healthy glow and that my makeup sits more evenly throughout the day. A little goes a long way, so the bottle should last a while. It's a great peptide ampoule if you're looking to boost hydration and improve skin texture. I'd definitely keep it in my nighttime skincare routine.

Overall, I can't really say if I got a lot of benefit from this. It didn't irritate my skin, but I didn't find it particularly hydrating either. The dropper is a bit difficult to use and took some effort. There was no bad odor and the texture was pleasant enough. I wish I'd noticed more difference though.

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. I love this product! I use actives tret and azalaeic acid so my skin can be very dry sometimes flakey. Since using this product my skin has felt and looked the healthiest it has been. I've had zero flakes, it's felt moisturised and plump. The serum is thick, but I feel that is what makes it feel so luxurious to use and work so well. It sits well under actives and moisturiser. I did not try this under make up. The only downside is the packaging, because the serum is so thick I think it would benefit from being in a pump rather than a pipette. It can be a little tricky getting it into/out of the pipette. I am so thankful for being introduced to this product I have been on the hunt for a nourishing moisturising serum for a long time and I think this is it!

I've been using the Lab in Nature Matrixyl Boosting Shot Ampoule for a few weeks, and I'm really happy with the results. It has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and smooth. I noticed my skin looks firmer, more radiant, and my fine lines appear softer with consistent use. Overall, it's a great ampoule for hydration and improving skin elasticity. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a simple anti-aging boost in their skincare routine.

avis.titre: Summer Fridays Jet Lag serum dupe!!
avis.texte: This product reminds me of Summer Friday's jet lag serum. This one is more lightweight, but still deeply moisturizing. Absorbs quickly and doesn't pill or feel tacky. My skin looks glowy and plump all day long. A great supplement to my skincare soutine!

I've been using this product for a week or so now and it's pretty good. I did notice it stings a bit when I first put it on, not sure if it's because I have more sensitive skin or it's supposed to do that? The feeling doesn't last long and I haven't noticed any redness afterwards. It does make my skin soft, but I do feel like I still need another moisturizing product on top of it; again, that could just be how my skin is. I think it's a good product to add to a routine, but not one I would use to replace anything. I will say, though, the applicator is awful! I can barely get any product out of it and have to do multiple squeezes. That's a huge reason why I knocked off one of the stars. I'd still recommend it, but just wanted to leave an honest review!

As someone with sensitive skin I'm always interested in serums with spicules but nervous. This one has that bit of a tingly feeling but nothing extreme and I didn't notice any irritation. The texture is on the thicker side which my skin really likes and I'm happy with the plumping effect so far! Gifted by brand.
My face and skin look stunning after applying this product. The micro needles are not bad, and it really helps my other serums and lotions work very well.
I've been using this product everyday and am seeing a smoother and brighter texture. I received this product as part of a campaign.

I'm always really excited to try serums and other products to help repair my skin barrier because my skin usually feels dry/irritated and this product does feel like it's helping. It's an added bonus that's it s great for anti-aging. I've great results with it, feels very lightweight and hydrating. Also, it sits very well under makeup.

avis.titre: Great product to add to routine!
avis.texte: I thing long term this is going to work really well and do wonders for my skin. It took a little adjusting to but once my skin got used to it I have seen improvement already. My skin is smoothers and softer. Excited to add to my normal routine!

I've only been using this for about two weeks now so I'm not sure if that's long enough for noticeable results. The texture is lightweight which I do enjoy. I'm really looking forward to continuing this to see the full effects. At this time I don't have any negative reviews. I would purchase again simply due to the texture and how I do feel like my face seems at least slighter softer and plumper

Gifted by Skin1004. I was intrigued by this ampoule because of the active ingredients, and it didn't disappoint! The combo of ingredients leaves my skin looking plump, hydrated, and bouncy! Love that it includes centella to keep everything soothing and calm. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and gives my skin a refreshed and firm look!

avis.titre: Good, but not substantially better than The Ordinary
avis.texte: I've been using The Ordinary matrixyl for several years, and at 3x the price, I'm not convinced that this is 3x as good. It does have a lovely milky texture, but I will stick to my The Ordinary serum and won't be rebuying. I received this product at no cost in exchange for my review.
I loved this product, especially for my sensitive skin. I looked dewy and plump after using it for a few days between my tret. I do think it needs a new dropper though, my only complaint.

This boosting shot is amazing. I have never used such an amazing skin care product ever. I have tried out so many skin care items and this is by far the best yet. I just wished it was a lot more product besides the small amount they give you.

Thank you BzzAgent for the free product in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this serum for a few weeks now and have been enjoying it. It leaves my skin glowing, hydrated, and smooth. You get a good amount of product in the bottle as well. It does have a lotion-like smell until it dries, which may be off-putting to some, but it didn't bother me.

I've been using the Lab in Nature Matrixyl 10 Boosting Shot for a few weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed. The watery, fast-absorbing texture makes it effortless to layer, and it plays well under moisturizer and my skin feels noticeably plumper. From an esthetician's standpoint, this ampoule is a smart formulation. Matrixyl, a matrikine peptide, works by signaling the skin to produce more collagen and elastin, which makes it an excellent choice for those starting to address early signs of aging or looking to maintain skin resilience. My esthetician pointed out that peptide-rich products like this are ideal for strengthening a compromised skin barrier, and because it's fragrance-free and gentle, it's well-suited even for sensitive or reactive skin types. She also noted that pairing it with a good moisturizer helps seal in the peptides for better efficacy, and the simple ingredient list here minimizes the risk of irritation—a big plus when introducing active ingredients. Whether you're new to peptides or looking to add a no-fuss booster to your routine, this one earns a permanent spot on my shelf.
This product doesn't leave skin sticky or oily I have been enjoying using this product in my morning return under my makeup to leave skin soft and smooth

avis.titre: Nice product to give a try
avis.texte: Been using it for about a week, so I can't say much about the firm looking effect. However my skin indeed feels hydrating with a bit of tingling

So I've been using this product to correct the deep lines on my forehead and over the last few days I have noticed a difference. The lines aren't gone but they are definitely less pronounced! It applied like a thick serum and after a few seconds I rub it in. I got this product for free in exchange for a review.
I really love the texture of it and it works wonderfully! It has a pleasant smell as well. It started firming the skin in just a few uses.
I haven't used this product long but it has a nice texture. It is somewhat hard to get the product out of the container. I wish it was a different design. Seems to be hydrating.

I absolutely love this serum. I have noticed a huge difference in the hydration and plumpness of my skin. My fine lines are diminished and my skin glows because it not only looks hydrated but feels it too. This serum melts seamlessly into my skin and feels lightweight. Not sticky or tacky. It's great under makeup, no pilling. I have been using this for 2 weeks and I can tell you I will be incorporating it into my skincare routine from now on. It's that good.

I received this product in exchange for an honest review. I was curious about trying Matrixyl so I was excited to get this. I've been using it for about 2 weeks and can honestly see a little bit of a difference in my skin. I have nasolabial folds that drive me crazy. I used this product every night for the last 2 weeks and have seen a slight improvement. They weren't deep to begin with but I wanted to make them smaller/tighter. The only thing I would say I would be hesitant on.. if you're super sensitive… rubbing the product in kinda feels sharp. Like little pricks when you rub it in. I guess there are micro-spicules in it. Theyre like micro-needles that create micro-pathways to push actives deeper into the skin. It just feels prickly when you rub it in and nothing after. I'd recommend this to anyone who is interested in getting firmer skin.

It is a bit hard to get the product out of the container and I've been using for a bit now but haven't noticed any changes in my skin. I do feel a bit of tingling when I apply it at least. I got the product for free in exchange for writing the review.

avis.titre: I have that mid life skin needing a boost
avis.texte: Hey ladies! I've got that almost 40 skin and was in need of a refresh. I received this product and lo and behold I started noticing smother texture, a little firmer under my eyes, a glow that I had been looking for! I use this about 2-3 times a week, at night, under my moisturizer, a small pea sized amount. A little of this goes a long way! I love it! When I researched the price, I'm shocked at the value I received for such a low price point. Will buy again!

Ill start with the pros for me. I enjoy the spicules, I feel they allow the serum to penetrate deeper. The serum is hydrating but not botox in a bottle. The con is definitely the pipette and packaging. Its hard to get the product out of the packaging. The ingredients that ate advertised as botox like are lowest on the the list. There are other products that offer similar effects. I have enjoyed using this serum once I get it out of the packaging. I would start of slow with using the spiculated serum and work my way up. It could be irritating to some sensitive skin.
Im a little up in the air about this one. For the most part it did what it was intended to do so i guess it's a good product.
This left my skin soook clear. My red spots calmed down a lot and I felt like my makeup applied smoothly. I have been using it 2-3x a week with my regular routine.

I've been using this product for a little while now and really like it. It feels lightweight, it absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin hydrated without feeling sticky! My skin looks smoother and feels softer, and I like the subtle plumping effect. The only downside is the slight tingling when you first apply it, but it fades quickly. I thought it was because I have dry patches and red irritated skin but my sister tried it and she also felt the tingling. Then I researched and realized it's the mineral micro particles that stimulate the skin. Overall, a great addition to my skincare routine and love the science behind it!

My first impression is that the texture is very lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. After using it, my skin feels softer, more hydrated, and looks healthier. I really like how gentle and comfortable it feels, making it easy to add to my daily skincare routine
I really enjoyed this treatment! It went on smooth and left my skin very soft. It easily absorbed and worked well with my sensitive skin. It is my new go to product to apply before bed.

I have used matrixyl in products before and typically end up needing to slowly work it into my routine because it can be quite strong, and will dry out my skin if I use it daily. This formula seems to offer a lot of extra hydration and does not feel as harsh when used daily, which has been great. It offers a great glow on my skin, however when layered with other products it can feel a bit heavy and leave me looking a little too shiny/dewy if I use it during the day. Overall, my biggest issue is the actual packaging. The formula of the product is quite thick, and the dropper used can barely pick up the product and I often have to try going back into the bottle and sucking up more product 2-4 times before having enough to cover my entire face. Because of how thick this formula is, I think it's best if only used at night, similar to a retinoid. It works great when applied with other retinoids and has been helping plump up fine lines and make them less noticeable. I can't wait to see the results the more I continue using this! Received free in exchange for my honest review.
I would definitely buy this again. This feels so light and silky on my skin. I feel like i can see improvements as time goes on

This will give you a beautiful glow to your skin. You have to start using small amounts in target areas & gradually work your way up to using it over the entire face. It can have a slight tingle. Just take your time with it. I don't know how it works on fine lines, haven't used it long enough.
